response.overview: An Iraqi experimental documentary traces a recurring pattern across history: powerful figures, scientists and mystics reaching toward intelligences they did not fully understand. As angels, demons and gods begin to look like different names for the same unknown presence, Al Haykal follows the possibility that humanity unleashed something it can no longer control. A predator whose influence may run through the human story itself.
response.tagline: Humanity was never at the top of the food chain.
response.title: Al Haykal: The Black Star
